results.title: The Best Books of 2020: Nature! — Open Letters Review
results.content: The book is one of many such front-line accounts this year, turning a spotlight on the unsung heroes of conservation, and it’s the best one. From grand, sweeping campaigns to save entire species of large, charismatic animals like panthers or fish owls, we turn to the very small and very un-charismatic for this, the best Nature title of 2020, in which John Hainze takes a lovingly detailed look at creatures most people consider toxic vermin: crabgrass, fruit flies, dandelions - all the first kinds of things most people want to eliminate from park or garden.
